policy_title: Give Police New Powers and Tools
stated: The Conservative Party will back the police by giving officers new powers and tools to catch criminals, including technology like facial recognition and powers to seize knives and track down stolen property, while supporting lawful use of force.

source.quote: Back the police, by giving officers new powers and tools to catch criminals, including technology like facial recognition and powers to seize knives and track down stolen property. We will always back the police in the lawful and professional use of force, alongside a fair and proportionate accountability system.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets crime detection and prevention through new policing powers and tools, affecting crime rates, charge/conviction outcomes, and public safety.

Facial recognition is a mass-surveillance technology (privacy/surveillance indicator); new stop-and-seize powers expand state coercive authority over individuals — both concretely worsen personal liberty and freedom from state coercion.

NIST and Home Office evidence document higher facial-recognition error rates for darker-skinned individuals and persistent racial disproportionality in stop-and-search — new powers using these tools plausibly worsen equal treatment and minority-protection indicators.

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: O5 (the protective safety gain), O10 (the liberty cost of surveillance and coercive powers), and O9 (discriminatory-impact risk from facial recognition bias and historically unequal stop-and-search application). All three have concrete mechanisms and specific indicators.
